method: All 2,353 weights and biases included, activation slope fixed. PCA fitted to 199 checkpoints nearest 200 uniformly spaced training steps; all 500 checkpoints projected onto its top two axes. Plane origin is final weights. No retraining or parameter normalization. Grid samples the full models in this plane. Resampled at 129 × 129; trajectory metadata and coordinate extent preserved exactly.
limits: One two-dimensional slice of parameter space. Actual full-network evaluations on a fixed training subset, not held-out data. No retraining, synthetic roughness, or smoothing. The path is projected; its heights evaluate projected models on this same subset.
title: Training trajectory plane
